About us
Alliance University is the first private university in South 
India, established in Karnataka under Act No. 34 of 
2010, and recognized by the University Grants 
Commission (UGC), New Delhi. The University was 
awarded an A+ grade by NAAC in 2024, reflecting its 
commitment to academic excellence.
At Alliance University, research is the cornerstone of 
teaching and learning, fostering a strong synergy 
between knowledge creation and application. The 
University aims to tackle real-world challenges at local, 
national, and global levels by acting as a hub for 
collaboration among industry, government, civil 
society, and the community.
In an era of rapid technological and social 
transformation, Alliance University embraces diverse 
disciplines and specializations while promoting the 
integration of knowledge to prepare students for the 
evolving demands of employability and global 
leadership.

Welcome to
Alliance ONE has evolved into a distinctive academic and cultural platform—one that goes far beyond 
a conventional university festival. It reflects the intellectual, creative, and civic identity of Alliance 
University: confident, curious, socially engaged, and deeply conscious of its role in shaping the 
future.
Over the years, Alliance ONE has been anchored in the spirit of the United Nations Sustainable 
Development Goals (SDGs). Our commitment to equity, inclusion, sustainability, innovation, and 
community well-being is not symbolic—it is intentional and consistent.
Mr. Abhay G. Chebbi
Pro-Chancellor
Alliance University
The 2026 edition marks an important inflection point. Guided by the 
theme Equity. Empowerment. Excellence., it places a focused lens on 
the role of women in leadership, creativity, innovation, and societal 
transformation. This year also invites students to engage deeply with the 
realities of Bengaluru—a city shaped by aspiration, complexity, and 
constant reinvention.
In essence, Alliance ONE is not merely a 
celebration—it is a platform for purpose. My 
appreciation to the students, faculty mentors, and 
partners who have shaped this edition.

--- Page Break ---

At Alliance University, we believe that education must go beyond classrooms and curricula—it must 
prepare individuals to lead, to create, to solve, and to serve. In that spirit, it gives me great pleasure 
to welcome you to Alliance ONE 2026, a flagship celebration that reflects the energy, imagination, 
and capability of our student community.
Alliance ONE is not merely a festival of events; it is a platform for purposeful growth. It fosters 
leadership through responsibility, character through competition, and excellence through 
collaboration. Whether on the stage, on the field, or in the arena of ideas, every participant is 
encouraged to challenge conventions and build confidence that endures.
I commend the student leaders, faculty mentors, and staff whose dedication 
has brought this vision to life. To every participant, I extend my best wishes: 
engage wholeheartedly, compete with integrity, learn generously, and 
celebrate unity. May Alliance ONE 2026 inspire excellence and remind us 
that true success lies in the impact we create and the values we uphold.
Dr. B. Priestly Shan
Vice-Chancellor
Alliance University

--- Page Break ---

Alliance University proudly presents Alliance ONE – 4th Edition, a premier national fest that brings 
together the brightest minds from across the country. Scheduled from February 19 - 21, 2026, this 
extraordinary convergence celebrates intellect, creativity, innovation, and sportsmanship, offering a 
transformative experience where collaboration fuels progress and ideas transcend boundaries.
Alliance ONE unites the collective strengths of the Alliance School of Business, Alliance School of 
Applied Engineering, Alliance School of Advanced Computing, Alliance School of Performing, 
Visual & Creative Arts, Alliance School of Design, Alliance School of Law, Alliance School of Liberal 
Arts & Humanities, Alliance Ascent College, and ATHLOS (Sports). More than a competition, this 
prestigious festival stands as a catalyst for sustainability, innovation, and global impact.
Anchored in the vision of the 17 United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), participants 
will engage in high-impact challenges spanning business strategy, technological innovation, artistic 
expression, legal discourse, and competitive sports. Whether your passion lies in innovation, 
problem-solving, creativity, advocacy, or athletic excellence, Alliance ONE – 4th Edition offers the 
ultimate platform to lead, inspire, and drive meaningful change.
With the theme Equity. Empowerment. Excellence., Alliance ONE – 4th Edition places women at the 
heart of innovation and leadership, while challenging students to address Bengaluru’s real-world 
needs around mobility, inclusivity, sustainability, and access. Bringing together diverse 
disciplines—from business and technology to design, law, the arts, and sport—this edition celebrates 
women-led solutions and collective action to build a more equitable, future-ready Bengaluru.
Reimagine possibilities. Transcend limits. Shape the future.
Alliance ONE – 4th Edition awaits you.
